create_recipe.description: Write a recipe into Mealie from its name, ingredients and steps, such as one an AI step read from an email or a photo of a card.

mock_response.description: Eggs poached in a spiced tomato and pepper sauce.
mock_response.name: Weeknight Shakshuka
steps: Soften the onion in the oil.
Add the tomatoes and simmer, then crack in the eggs.
mock_response.text:
Weeknight Shakshuka
Eggs poached in a spiced tomato and pepper sauce.
Serves 4 | Prep 10 min | Cook 25 min | Total 35 min

Ingredients
- 2 tablespoons olive oil
- 1 onion, diced
- 6 eggs

Steps
1. Soften the onion in the oil.
2. Add the tomatoes and simmer, then crack in the eggs.

Source: https://recipes.example.com/shakshuka
